name: Wills
overview: Scripture reveals that the will of God is central to the believer's life, calling for submission and transformation. Jesus exemplifies this in His prayer at Gethsemane, surrendering His own desires to the Father's will (Luke 22:42), while the Lord’s Prayer teaches us to seek God's will on earth as it is in heaven (Matthew 6:10). Believers are urged to be renewed in mind to discern and prove the good, acceptable, and perfect will of God (Romans 12:2), and to obey His commands as a means of knowing divine truth (John 7:17). The concept of covenant or testament, referenced in Galatians 3:15, underscores the binding nature of God's promises and directives, highlighting the seriousness of aligning with His will.
